name: A set-aside held in a pot: the unfilled part is reserved at its learned source, and the pot is never spendable (G230, G238)

expected.notes: A set-aside kept in a pot, mid-period: today Thu 8 Oct 2026, pay period last Friday, so the period runs Fri 25 Sep to Thu 29 Oct and payday Fri 30 Oct is 22 days away (window days 0 to 21). Barclays Current holds 3,000 and the Holiday Pot (savings) 800. Bills: personal loan 400 (Thu 15 Oct, day 7), council tax 150 (Tue 20 Oct, day 12). The salary is due on payday, day 22, outside the window. The set-aside is 200 a period, filled by credits to the pot whose description contains SET ASIDE. One fill has already landed this period: 50 on Mon 28 Sep, paired with the same-day, same-amount 50 debit on Barclays, which is how the source is learned (the transfer source is Barclays, the only other account with that debit). Remaining = 200 - 50 = 150, the unfilled part, never the full 200 on top of an already reduced balance. Left to spend: pool = counted current accounts only = 3,000 (the pot is savings, in no pool, however much it holds). Walk: 3,000 - 400 = 2,600; - 150 = 2,450. Lowest point 2,450; less the 150 set aside, Left to spend is 2,300. Positions: Barclays walk after payments 2,450, low point 2,450; the 150 is reserved at its learned source, so plans reserved 150, after payments and plans 2,300, low point and plans 2,300, and the headroom the cover-plan finder reads is 2,450 - 150 - 10 = 2,290. Spend from min(2,300, 2,300) = 2,300, equal to the pool. The pot is never spendable: it is not in the pooled balance (3,000 is exactly the counted accounts), the client shows no availability and no Spend from for it, and it is not a payment source for any walk. Nobody is short, so no cover move; at risk 0. The period began on 25 Sep (day 14 today), so no payday plan.
